SELECT SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20) AS reason_desc,
       AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
       AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash,
       AVG(wr_fee) AS avg_fee
FROM (
    SELECT 
        wr.wr_reason_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity AS ws_quantity,
        wr.wr_refunded_cash AS wr_refunded_cash,
        wr.wr_fee AS wr_fee,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_returns wr 
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk 
        AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN web_page wp 
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca 
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    JOIN date_dim dd 
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r 
        ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 
        ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 
        ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 1998
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
        AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA')
        AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
        AND (
            (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' 
             AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' 
             AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
            OR
            (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S'
